TL;DR for investors

  • Large, emotionally resonant problem: 75% of American teens lack basic financial literacy.
  • AI-native solution that adapts to each child and connects parents to the loop.
  • Early traction: 10 schools, 120+ students, 200+ WAU, $0 paid marketing.

The Opportunity

75% of American teens lack basic financial literacy. Only 23 states require personal finance in high schools. Parents want to teach their kids but don't know how, and kids are learning about money from TikTok and costly trial-and-error. The result is a generation entering adulthood without the skills to manage debt, build credit, or invest.

The Solution

MoneyBot meets kids on their phones with an AI tutor that adapts to each child's age, knowledge level, and interests. Kids go from "What's a stock?" to explaining compound interest to their parents. The product combines conversational AI, gamified lessons, quests, and a parent dashboard into one simple experience.

Business Model

B2C subscription at $9.99/month or $79/year per family, with school district licenses in development. Organic teacher-to-parent adoption keeps customer acquisition costs low and creates a natural expansion path from classroom to home.

Go-to-Market

  1. School Pilots: Free classroom pilots create teacher champions and drive home adoption.
  2. Parent Conversion: Kids bring progress reports home; parents subscribe for full access.
  3. District Expansion: Proven usage converts individual teachers into district-wide deals.

Competitive Edge

Existing solutions are curriculum-heavy, expensive, or not built for how kids communicate. MoneyBot is AI-native, phone-first, and parent-connected. See the full competitive matrix at moneybot.com/competition.

Team

Kahlil Garmon, Founder & CEO. Previously built gamification systems at MyXR and implemented technology at a construction company. Board member at the Kentucky Center for Leadership. Full-time on MoneyBot since January 2026.

Investment Thesis

MoneyBot is attacking a large, emotionally resonant problem at the right moment: AI makes personalized education scalable for the first time, schools are under pressure to teach financial literacy, and parents are desperate for help. Early organic traction proves the product works and the channel is real.
